summary: Head-to-head randomized comparison testing for superiority is needed to compare aspirin vs. clopidogrel monotherapy after DAPT.
research_recommendations: Conduct a randomized trial directly comparing aspirin monotherapy with clopidogrel monotherapy following DAPT.

summary: The role of percutaneous MCS (mechanical circulatory support) devices in patients presenting with ACS (acute coronary syndrome) and CS (cardiogenic shock) remains unclear.
research_recommendations: Randomized comparisons between standard of care and percutaneous MCS devices in ACS with CS are needed.

summary: Clinical improvement through the use of risk stratification based on validated risk prediction models is highlighted.
research_recommendations: Randomize patients to a particular intervention or to usual care based on validated risk prediction models to assess clinical benefit.

summary: Questions include whether intravascular imaging-guided revascularization strategy improves clinical outcomes in patients with ACS.

Whether intracoronary physiology assessment of myocardial reperfusion after PPCI improves risk stratification and enables stratified medicine to limit microvascular dysfunction and reperfusion injury/MVO post-ACS.
In ACS patients with an IRA (infarct-related artery) unsuitable for stent implantation, whether drug-coated balloon treatment of the IRA improves clinical outcomes.
Microvascular obstruction associated with PPCI represents an unmet clinical need; development of therapies for prevention and treatment of MVO is urgently needed.
research_recommendations: RCTs evaluating the efficacy of an intravascular imaging-guided revascularization strategy to improve meaningful clinical outcomes in patients with ACS.
Prospective evaluation to determine whether intracoronary physiology assessment of myocardial reperfusion better stratifies patient risk.
Randomized trials of patients with an IRA unsuitable for stent implantation comparing drug-coated balloon treatment versus usual care to evaluate clinical outcomes.
Pre-clinical and clinical research to evaluate cardioprotective therapies aimed at reducing microvascular obstruction.
